description: Implement NextAuth on frontend (Task 6.2) and Login/Register UI screens (Task 6.3).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts with NextAuth configuration using CredentialsProvider that calls the backend POST /auth/login endpoint, stores JWT in session
Create apps/web/src/lib/auth.ts exporting authOptions with session callback that includes userId, role, accessToken in the session, and jwt callback that handles token refresh logic

Create apps/web/src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx with login form: email + password inputs, Zod client-side validation, error display using ProblemDetails format, submit calls signIn('credentials'), redirects to / on success

Create apps/web/src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx with registration form: email + password + displayName, validates with Zod, calls backend /auth/register directly, on success auto-logs in and redirects to onboarding placeholder
Create apps/web/src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx with centered card layout for auth pages, dark theme styling
Create apps/web/src/middleware.ts for route protection: redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes to /login, redirect authenticated users from /login and /register to /
Run pnpm install, then pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify
acceptance_criteria: NextAuth is configured with CredentialsProvider hitting backend /auth/login
Login page has email/password form with Zod validation and error display
Register page has email/password/displayName form with Zod validation
Middleware protects routes and redirects appropriately
